tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Search prepaid travel eSIM data plans by destination country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "JP"), region (e.g. "Europe"), minimum data in GB, maximum total price, or plan duration in days. Returned price is the final amount the customer pays at checkout (all fees included), in the requested currency. To

tools.name: get_esim_plan
tools.description: Fetch full details of a single Siima eSIM plan by its id (from search_esim_plans). To buy: call create_checkout_link with the plan id, give the returned URL to the user. After payment the eSIM (QR code + activation link + manual codes) is emailed to them automatically — no account needed.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a secure payment link on siima.io for a Siima eSIM plan (Stripe-powered, but hosted on our own site — never a redirect to checkout.stripe.com). tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List all countries Siima has eSIM plans for, with plan counts and the cheapest total price per country. Country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan · Public sink: create_checkout_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_esim_plans, get_esim_plan · Public sink: create_checkout_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
